feedback: Strong, in-scope hardening that satisfies AC-H01..H06 with all four hard gates green (lint/tsc/201 unit/build). To raise the score further: (1) AC-H01 residual — the within-item getItem fallback chain (route.ts:123-131: getItem -> searchManageNumberBySku -> getItem) can fire up to ~2-3 mall calls per item with no intra-item throttle; consider applying delay or a small concurrency/limiter inside resolveRakutenItem, and add a test asserting it. (2) AC-H04 robustness — a 200-item synchronous request at delayMs=300 adds ~60s of sleep alone plus per-item API time, which can still approach serverless timeout and risks partial commit; prefer chunked/batched processing with resumable progress or lower the recommended cap, and add idempotency so a mid-run failure on commit is safely retryable. (3) integration — surface delayMs and preserveExistingDisplay in MigratePanel (or document) so operators can tune throttle/preserve without editing the request body. (4) Optional consistency — reconcile the single register/yahoo POST default (forces display='0' on update) with the bulk preserve default, or document why they intentionally differ, to avoid future confusion.
risks: 200-item synchronous request at delayMs=300 (~60s of sleeps + per-item mall/DB/image time) can still approach serverless timeout and partial commit; the count guard mitigates but does not chunk.
Intra-item getItem fallback (getItem -> SKU search -> getItem) is not rate-limited; bursts of 2-3 mall calls per item bypass the between-item delay.

ItemStatus 'skipped' is only emitted when callers set continueOnError=false; route default is continueOnError=true, so in the default production path 'skipped' remains unexercised (still honest, but reachable only on opt-in).
commit path has no idempotency/resume; a failure partway through a large run leaves Yahoo/DB partially updated with no automatic recovery.
recommended_next_changes: Implement chunked/batched commit (or a job/queue) with resumable progress for inputs near the cap, instead of one synchronous request, to remove timeout/partial-commit risk.
Throttle or limit the within-item getItem fallback chain and add a test verifying mall-call count per item under rate control.
Add idempotency keys / per-item commit checkpointing so a mid-run failure can be safely retried without double-registering.
Expose delayMs and preserveExistingDisplay in MigratePanel (with safe defaults) so operators can tune throttle and display-preserve behavior from the UI.
Document or reconcile the display-default divergence between bulk migrate (preserve existing) and single register/yahoo POST (forces display='0' on update).
